 Programme announcement
 Des Images Aux Mots is an LGBTQIA+ film festival centred on Toulouse, with screenings across Occitanie and Nouvelle-Aquitaine. Its programme connects queer features, documentaries and shorts with discussions, local artists and community events.
 The next edition is listed for 29 January to 2 March 2027. The organiser's current homepage still features its 2026 editorial and films, so those titles should not be presented as the 2027 selection.
